newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Rivlin says reducing federal deficit is key.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Rivlin says reducing federal deficit is key.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin told U.S. lawmakers on Wednesday that reducing the deficit now was more important than cutting taxes, and that reducing capital gains taxes would have scant economic effect.
Rivlin also told the House Banking Committee that she was not enthusiastic about proposals to cut capital gains taxes because she doubted that such a move would have much impact on the economy.

Fed Governor Laurence Meyer echoed Rivlin's preference for budget deficit cuts and said that he did not think that current Congressional efforts to balance the budget went far enough to tackle the long-term fiscal challenges.
"I don't think we have done quite enough in the bill," Meyer told the House Banking Committee.
